title: Empty-prefix call identity
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be an anchor state of $B$, and choose a startup marker, a configuration $c$ of $B$ on a Boolean input, a release bit, an optional flag bit, a Boolean word, and a configuration of $F$ on that input. If the output of $c$ is empty, then the forwarding call with empty prefix equals the corresponding capturing call.
hypotheses_covered: $B,F$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
The startup marker and release bit are Boolean
$c$ is a configuration of $B$ on a Boolean input and has empty output
The flag is an optional Boolean
The fuel configuration is a configuration of $F$ on the same input
replaced:
For every startup marker, body configuration $c$ with empty output, release bit, flag
bit, counter word, and fuel configuration, the forwarding call on $c$ with empty prefix
equals the corresponding capturing call on $c$.
